observations.body: Travel plans include Timothy and an unwilling Apollos. I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia. Now about Apollos the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.
